blocks.text: THE LAST CALL— Matt.25:10 — We should speak mainly of the Elect and translation. We're now entering the Midnight Cry and the Thunders are rolling, Rev.10:1-7. Who can but prophesy? — Amos 4:7. We’ve had the former and latter rain as spoken of in the Scriptures (James 5:7-8). These two rains are merging together forming the new rain of the quick short work, where Paul said it would be cut short in righteousness-quickly and suddenly. | would like to explain once again the difference between those who are translated and those who go through the tribulation. — In | Thess. 4:17 it says we are caught up together to meet Him in the air. This is the Translation. But in Zech. 14:3-4 it shows the end of the tribulation when He puts His foot down on the ground, Mount of Olives. We are with Him (Rev. 19:14). So you can see, one was in the air and the other was on the ground. How great is God who reveals His secrets to those that love Him! We are now dwelling in the secret place of the Most High (Ps.91).

NUMERICALS OF EL MESSIAH— The Lord has a way of giving us evidence not only in His word and celestial, but in numerical and symbols. For instance 666, the mark and the name of the antichrist are digital. They mean the same thing - satan’s number. In Rev. 13 it says count the number of his name. If you turn the 6’s up you get the different 999, judgment on him and his followers. You can change the 6 to 9. — Now concerning God’s name and numericals, it has been confirmed that His name Jesus is 888. If you turn it up; it’s still 888. It's infinite. | am the Lord, | change not. Heb 13:8, “Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and today, and forever.” The 8’s are digital. They all mean the same thing. Lord is God, Jesus — when he is Son, and Christ the anointed one, Holy Spirit. These three are one it says. The same as the 666’s all mean the same thing — imitation of God. It had the name, the mark and the number representing the same thing (Rev. 13:17). They’re digital. The Lord said there’s one thing | don’t know and that is another God, Isa.44:6 and Isa.9:6. You can just hear the Holy Spirit crackling all around me. Lord how sweet is His revelative word! O Lord, let the new rain fall! Praise Him!

PROPHETIC OPINIONS, PORTENTS OF PAST AND FUTURE— Explanation concerning the subject of #282 Scroll. — In Sept.9, 1899 a tremendous wind worked itself into a powerful hurricane wiping out Galveston, TX. Up until that time it was the worst disaster in U.S. history. — Entering the century, by 1901 a president was assassinated. 1903-05, the starting of the former rain, Holy Spirit outpouring began (Acts 2:4) leading to the later gifts, plus Amy McPherson era. By 1903-05 the industrial and car age developed. Nahum’s car vision commenced into our age, “rage in the streets, seem like torches, run like the lightning.” 1906 the great San Francisco earthquake, even greater than Galveston’s disaster. 1908, an anti-matter star fragment exploded over Siberia. Russia and leveled over 10,000 sq. mi. of timber with a force stronger than the atom bomb dropped in Japan. 1910-11, heavens shew forth a great comet carried by the news worldwide. And we also know by 1914, WWI - let us leap forward... Between 1997 and 2000 the appearance of great comets and celestial signs appear in a great way. Of course we saw the electronic and technology begin a new era of business, touching every facet of society and way of life. — Working in appliances, internet, etc. This will climax uniting the world false system. This is to bring out a point. Evidently by 2008 giant asteroids or comets could begin hitting like in Siberia; probably in sea and earth. Small ones begin and bigger ones will come. Like 1902-05 we also see the merging of the former and latter rain producing the new rain, the thunders, working into the quick short work. The Translation, the Midnight Cry is upon us. We should also watch after 2000 election. The presidential cycle of assassinations, if not been broken. Nevertheless the unexpected will haunt that office from now on. This gives you a birds-eye view, you might say, of the events similar to the beginning of the last century, occurring similar to our century, what is occurring now!

FULFILLMENT OF VITAL PROPHECY - The Bible revealed it and the Scripts give the season and added information. Time Magazine (date: Dec 4,2000) — Inventions quote: “Power. IBM just built the world’s fastest computer, capable of over 12 trillion calculations/second — enough power to process an online transaction from every man, woman, and child on earth in one minute.” Read Rev. 13:7, 16. He warred against the Tribulation saints. He had power over all kinds of tongues and nations. Watch and pray. The door is closing fast. Now every minute counts! — Continuing quote from Time Magazine. — The incredible knowledge of medicine. “Gut check: If we could see inside the human body, it would be a lot easier to pinpoint exactly what was wrong. The Given Diagnostic Imaging System is a camera tucked inside a tiny capsule that, when swallowed, takes a sci-fi jaunt through the body, beaming detailed color images to a patient-worn belt that are then down-loaded onto a computer for analysis.” It’s not been released yet but they will have even better ways of looking inside the body soon, as Scripts predicted. The antichrist era will also bring out sudden new inventions, etc. Dan 12:4 revealed the advancement and zenith of our age in science and technology.

Just before the end mystery Babylon will be destroyed by the ten kings, Rev.17:16, “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” Rev.13 and Rev.18 will continue for awhile longer and then be destroyed in Armageddon and the Day of the Lord. Right now and during the short period ahead the Euro Common Market will unite completely reviving the Roman Empire of old. Powerful dramatic events will occur concerning this, plus the U.S.A. and a covenant with Israel.

This last confusing election God is trying to alert people to tremendous events that are forming and others are already forming. Also, cataclysms of society, religion, politics, nature, weather, heavens, weapons, war (nuclear and biological), terrorists and sensual madness. — For instance, girls say, “I don’t count how many boys I’ve been with this week.” And the age of their activity is unbelievable — 8 -10 years old and onward. Sodom would pale in significance. Wickedness and idols are replacing God's spirit. As you can see we're headed for a catastrophic conclusion.

THE SHADOW OF DEATH - This nation is now going through such dramatic events concerning the election, the weather and astonishing occurrences. Society's minds have been taken off the fact, for a moment, that the drugs are destroying the youth (seeds) of this nation as predicted. Our last generation too! Countries like Columbia and elsewhere take advantage of these crises and even get some CIA agents, banks, Babylon churches and airlines to take huge bribes while they take their cocaine and heroin to the youth, USA and around the world. Right now they’re having war-like upheavals over drugs in Columbia. We can see the handwriting on the wall. America is going to wake up too late. Lives of the teenage boys and girls are fleeting like the winds of no return! Pray for our youth. The end is near. The return of Jesus is near! It causes them to do things like we mentioned above, that they ordinarily would not do. This nation is slowly turning from it’s lamb-like qualities to a dragon of delusion.

THE HOLY SPIRIT REVEALED THE FUTURE - As we spoke here and also wrote the political and the next election would be the unexpected, full of surprises and surrounded by mystery. And true to the word, the nation is in an uproar and in perplexity as the Supreme Court entered the scene of chaos. And now they say it has become a political tool, unexpected in the USA in this election. Unusual events indeed and more forthcoming. All of these things that we have written are going to cause vast changes in the US and world in the next 2-4 years. (At this writing they have settled for G.W. Bush.) All of these vital occurrences written in this script will have a vital impact on society and the nation in the future as sudden changes occur. We're entering an apocalyptic era of mystery and awesome events. (Just before the Supreme Court convened the above words were written. And afterwards the following:) The people may never know who really won the election. Even if they counted the votes again. But God knoweth! And also what could have happened in the other states? — By divine providence they will receive according to what they deserve. God allowed all of this and later people will be able to see because of the condition of the nation. But in the future they will see why as this nation draws closer to another type system. The world is full of troubles. — But we the Elect have this Scripture, Ps. 30:5, “For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favor is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.” A new day is dawning for the believer. The rains have merged into a quick short work. Praise Him!
